before.known: disse que queria saber quem era aquele homem
before.target: he said that he wanted to know who was that man

problem: Grammar: embedded question keeps inverted word order, 'who was that man'.
evidence: English should be 'who that man was'; the known 'quem era aquele homem' does not force the question order.

before.known: o meu pai queria saber quem era aquele homem ali
before.target: my father wanted to know who was that man over there

problem: Grammar: embedded question keeps inverted word order, 'who was that man over there'.
evidence: Same pattern as U01; natural English is 'who that man over there was'.

before.known: não faço a mínima ideia de quem era aquele homem
before.target: I don't have the faintest idea who was that man

problem: Grammar: 'I don't have the faintest idea who was that man' is ungrammatical.
evidence: An embedded question needs 'who that man was'.

before.known: a minha mãe queria saber quem era aquele homem
before.target: my mother wanted to know who was that man

problem: Grammar: embedded question with inverted order, 'wanted to know who was that man'.

before.known: conheci alguém que queria saber quem era aquele homem ali

problem: Grammar: embedded question with inverted order, 'wanted to know who was that man over there'.

before.known: quero vir connosco no próximo mês
before.target: I want to come with us next month

problem: Grammar and meaning: 'I want to come with us' is wrong, since the speaker cannot be both 'I' and 'us'.
evidence: Known 'quero vir connosco' implies 'I want to come with you'. That target is not available as a clean build.

before.known: queria saber se posso vir connosco no próximo mês
before.target: I wanted to know if I can come with us next month

problem: Grammar and meaning: 'I wanted to know if I can come with us' is wrong.
evidence: The speaker cannot come 'with us' while also being the 'I' who comes.

before.known: disse que parece uma ótima ideia
before.target: he said that sounds like a good idea

problem: Grammar: 'he said that sounds like a good idea' has no subject.
evidence: The known 'disse que parece uma ótima ideia' needs 'it' or 'that' before 'sounds' in English.

before.known: ela disse que parece uma ótima ideia para o próximo mês
before.target: she said that sounds like a good idea for next month

problem: Grammar: 'she said that sounds like a good idea' has no subject.

before.known: quando me disse parece uma ótima ideia fiquei feliz
before.target: when you said that sounds like a good idea I was happy

problem: Known-side clunkiness: 'quando me disse parece uma ótima ideia' is ungrammatical Portuguese, and the English is ambiguous.
evidence: The Portuguese lacks 'que' or a quote structure.

before.known: disse que parece uma ótima ideia e que quer vir connosco
before.target: he said that sounds like a good idea and he wants to come with us

problem: Grammar: 'he said that sounds like a good idea and he wants to come with us' has no subject for 'sounds'.

before.known: não posso ficar aqui mais um bocado
before.target: no I can stay here a little longer

problem: Meaning: known 'não posso' is translated as 'no I can', which says the opposite.
evidence: 'Não posso ficar aqui' means 'I can't stay here'. The English drops the negation and the 'no' reading is contradictory.

before.known: disse que só tinha de ir
before.target: he said that I only had to go

problem: Meaning: the known has no subject, but the English says 'he said that I only had to go', which mixes persons.
evidence: 'disse que só tinha de ir' maps to 'he said that I...', an inconsistent subject.

before.known: disse que só tinha de esperar mais um bocado
before.target: he said that I only had to stay here a little longer

problem: Mistranslation: 'esperar mais um bocado' is rendered 'stay here a little longer', and the persons are mixed.
evidence: The known says 'wait a little longer', not 'stay here'.

before.known: a minha mãe disse que está preocupado
before.target: my mother said that she is worried

problem: Agreement: the known uses masculine 'preocupado' for 'a minha mãe'.
evidence: The English says 'she is worried', which needs 'preocupada'.

before.known: disse que ia esperar pelo seu pai antes de começar
before.target: he said that he was going to wait for your father before going

problem: Meaning: 'antes de começar' is rendered 'before going'.

before.known: acho que devia terminar tudo ontem à noite
before.target: I think you should finish everything last night

problem: Meaning: known 'acho que devia' is rendered 'I think you should'.
evidence: The known has no 'you' subject, so it is a mistranslation.
